title: Polynomials and Factoring | Algebra I, Unit 8
description:
Add, subtract and multiply polynomials, use the special product patterns, factor out the GCF, factor trinomials with and without a leading coefficient, and factor differences of squares and perfect square trinomials. Each section ends with a practice problem.
